original_comparison: 7/7 cases byte- and definedness-exact (touched byte sets equal, values equal, descriptor placement equal) between native and unchanged retail 1cba48/1cd928 under Play DMAC/GIF; negative control (fixture-negative.txt) detects a 1-byte difference. Research-backend evidence, not physical PS2 proof. Allocator state is synthetic per case.
residual: Snapshot identities are per-lineage; a by-value copy forks counters; moved-from memory is not a valid snapshot source
failed allocate() moves search cursors without advancing ownership_epoch (documented)
upload_xim leaves image+earlier palettes live on later palette-allocation failure (retail binds null; unmodeled)
Per-snapshot cost ~1 MiB metadata copy; byte planes shared copy-on-write

results.handle_comparator: see commands/exit codes: new valid 0, descriptor/psm/height/id/byte negatives 1, malformed 2; old binary returns 0 for descriptor/psm/height/id negatives

retained_failures: First ASan run: texture-transfer-tests stack overflow (many ~768 KiB Ps2TextureMemory in main frame) and a test-builder heap overflow for CPSM2; fixed in tests (ae195f7).

Second-pass review found texture-snapshot-tests stack-overflows under ASan at 8 MB stack; invented upload_xim rollback; throw-after-allocate for tiny/oversize images; fixed in the review-response commit.
First rollback test geometry failed (image did not fit because 32-block permuted groups); replaced by record-exhaustion construction.
Handle A3 review finding (efe9863): comparator ignored descriptor words (width bit flip reported 7 MATCH, exit 0); constructed descriptor then discarded it, fixture reads were unchecked.

Handle: retained fixture-negative.txt turned out to be an out-of-range-address substitution (9999999); the strict reader now rejects it as malformed (exit 2) instead of DIFF; in-range byte negatives were added.
Handle: first unittest run of the old comparator binary against malformed inputs drove it to ~56 GB RSS (uninitialised fields); killed, bounded with OKAGE_TRANSFER_TIMEOUT.
scope: Early raw-transfer phases and immutable snapshot groundwork only.

handle_comparator.binary_note: build/ is untracked; binaries are bound by hash only and are not byte-reproducible across toolchains.
handle_comparator.descriptor_semantics: observer emits two 32-bit words [lo,hi]; lo tbp 0-13 tbw 14-19 id 20-31; hi psm 0-5 width 6-17 height 18-29; compared with native allocate() 64-bit descriptor. id is comparable only because both sides start from an empty/reset allocator FIFO.
handle_comparator.old_binary_malformed_behaviour: On truncated/non-numeric headers the old comparator reads uninitialised fields; during the unittest run one such input drove it to ~56 GB RSS before it was killed (OKAGE_TRANSFER_TIMEOUT bounds this in the tests).
handle_comparator.retained_byte_negative_note: fixture-negative.txt substitutes address 9 with 9999999 (>= 4 MiB). The old comparator reported case 5 DIFF (exit 1); the strict comparator rejects it as malformed (exit 2, 'address out of range'). In-range byte negatives are generated: byte-value-negative.txt, byte-address-moved-negative.txt (exit 1, case 5 DIFF).
